info.title: Field Planner Activity Service
info.description:
eGov DIGIT `field-planner-activity` service. Manages Activities, Activity-Facility linkages (project field-plan execution against facilities), Activity Assignments, Activity Facility Staff, facility workflow (approval) transitions, and Bill of Material (BOM) records/PDFs for facilities.

**Authentication**: This service does not use an `Authorization` HTTP header. Every authenticated endpoint instead expects a `RequestInfo` object embedded in the JSON request body, whose `authToken` field carries the Bearer JWT issued by eGov-user's OAuth login (`POST /user/oauth/token` or `POST /user/_login`). The platform gateway/services resolve the caller's identity from `RequestInfo.authToken` plus the accompanying `RequestInfo.userInfo` block (uuid, userName, roles, tenantId) - there is no separate header-based auth scheme for this service's own endpoints. The `/health` endpoint is the only exception and requires no `RequestInfo`/auth at all.

All list/mutation endpoints return a `ResponseInfo` envelope alongside the domain payload, and all synchronous exceptions raised anywhere in the service are funneled through egov-tracer's generic `ExceptionAdvise`, which always responds `HTTP 400` with the standard `ErrorRes` shape (`{"ResponseInfo": ..., "Errors": [...]}` ). 401/403/404/500 responses documented below are not emitted by this service's own code (its handler always answers 400) but are included for completeness since they can originate from an API gateway, ingress/auth layer, reverse proxy, or the servlet container in front of this service.

servers.description: Context path configured via server.servlet.context-path in application.properties

tags.name: Activity Facility
tags.description: Linkage of an Activity/Field-Plan to a Facility, its lifecycle and search

tags.name: Activity Assignment
tags.description: Assignment of an Activity (Field Plan) to a user/role

tags.name: Activity Facility Staff
tags.description: Linkage of field staff users to an Activity Facility

post.description: Creates master Activity record(s) (e.g. "Installation", "Maintenance") that can later be linked to facilities. Requires RequestInfo.authToken for authentication.

Updates one or more existing Activity-Facility linkage records (e.g. reassigning staff, updating status/additional details). Despite the `/activities/_update` path, the payload and response operate on ActivityFacility, not the master Activity.
Soft-deletes one or more Activity-Facility linkage records.

202.description: Activity Facility record(s) accepted for deletion

post.summary: Search Activity Facilities (with transactions, comments and workflow state)
post.description: Searches Activity-Facility linkage records by the given criteria, and enriches each match with its transactions, transaction comments, and process-instance (workflow) history.

200.description: Matching Activity Facilities, each with transactions, comments and workflow state

post.description: Creates one or more Activity Assignment records, capturing the linkage of a Field Plan/Activity to the user it is assigned to.
Updates one or more existing Activity Assignment records.
Searches Activity Assignment records by the given criteria.
Unassigns (soft-deletes/marks unassigned) one or more Activity Assignment records that link a Field Plan to a facility/user.

post.summary: Assign field staff / vendor to Activity Facility(s)
post.description: Creates Activity-Facility linkage record(s), capturing the assignment of a Project/Field-Plan Activity to a Facility (and its field staff/vendor).

post.summary: Apply a workflow action (approve/reject/etc.) to a single Activity Facility
post.description: Transitions the workflow state of a single Activity Facility (e.g. from INITIATED to APPROVED) and records any accompanying transactions.

200.description: Workflow transitioned; the updated Activity Facility, its transactions and process-instance history are returned

post.summary: Apply a workflow action in bulk to multiple/all matching Activity Facilities
post.description: Applies the same workflow action across either an explicit list of Activity Facility ids, or all facilities matching a search filter (when `isAllSelected` is true). Response status reflects the outcome: `200` when every facility succeeded, `207 Multi-Status` when some succeeded and some failed, `400` when every facility failed.

207.description: Partial success: some Activity Facilities succeeded and some failed

400.description: Either every selected Activity Facility failed the workflow transition (business-logic failure, body is `BulkFacilityUpdateResponse` with an empty `succeededProjectIDs`), or the request itself was invalid (validation/parsing failure, body is the standard `ErrorRes` shape).

allFailed.summary: All facilities failed the workflow transition

post.description: Creates one or more records linking an Activity Facility to a staff user.

202.description: Activity Facility Staff linkage(s) accepted and created

post.description: Updates one or more existing Activity Facility Staff linkage records.

202.description: Activity Facility Staff linkage(s) accepted and updated

post.description: Soft-deletes one or more Activity Facility Staff linkage records.

202.description: Activity Facility Staff linkage(s) accepted for deletion

post.summary: [Debug/test endpoint] Publish an Activity Facility payload onto the internal Kafka audit topic
post.description: Internal test/debug endpoint. Wraps the given ActivityFacilityBulkRequest into a Kafka record (topic `save-activity-facility-topic`) and publishes it to the `process-audit-records` Kafka topic via KafkaTemplate, then returns a bare confirmation string. Not part of the documented public API surface, and not wrapped in the standard ResponseInfo envelope.

post.summary: Create one or more Bill of Material records
post.description: Creates Bill of Material (BOM) record(s) for a facility/activity facility.
Updates one or more existing Bill of Material records.
Searches Bill of Material records by the given criteria.

post.summary: Generate a BOM PDF and stream it back
post.description: Renders the given BOM data into a PDF document and returns the raw PDF bytes as an attachment (`report.pdf`).

post.summary: Generate a BOM PDF and persist it to the filestore
post.description: Renders the given BOM data into a PDF, saves it to the eGov filestore service, and returns the resulting filestore id. Unlike most other endpoints in this service, the response is a bare JSON map and is not wrapped in a ResponseInfo envelope.

200.description: PDF generated and saved; filestore id returned

get.description: Unauthenticated health-check endpoint. Does not take a RequestInfo and requires no authentication - suitable for use as a Kubernetes liveness/readiness probe.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

includeDeleted.name: includeDeleted
includeDeleted.description: Whether soft-deleted records should be included in the search results.

lastChangedSince.name: lastChangedSince
lastChangedSince.description: Epoch millis; when provided, only records changed after this time are returned.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request - request failed bean validation, JSON parsing, or a business rule check raised a `CustomException`. All exceptions in this service are funneled through egov-tracer's generic `ExceptionAdvise`, which always answers HTTP 400 with this shape.

Errors.description: The field 'tenantId' is required and was not provided

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized - the caller's `RequestInfo.authToken` is missing, malformed or expired. Not raised by this service's own code (its handler always answers 400); included for completeness as this is typically enforced by an API gateway / egov-user token validation filter in front of the service.

Errors.description: The auth token provided in RequestInfo.authToken could not be validated against egov-user

Forbidden.description: Forbidden - the authenticated user does not hold a role permitted to perform this action. Not raised by this service's own code (its handler always answers 400); included for completeness as this is typically enforced by role-based access control at the gateway.

Errors.description: The user's roles do not permit this operation

NotFound.description: Not Found - no route matches the request path, or (for update/search flows) the referenced entity id does not exist.

Errors.description: No record was found for the given id(s)

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error - an unexpected/uncaught failure (e.g. database or downstream service outage).

Errors.description: An unexpected error occurred while processing the request

ActivityFacilityUserExample.summary: An Activity Facility Staff linkage record

RequestInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT RequestInfo envelope. Every authenticated request body in this service must include this object.

apiId.description: Unique API id of the calling client/module.

msgId.description: Unique message id for this request; echoed back in ResponseInfo.msgId/resMsgId.

requesterId.description: Id of the user making the request.

authToken.description: **Authentication carrier for this service.** The Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's OAuth login (`POST /user/oauth/token` or `POST /user/_login`). This service has no separate `Authorization` header scheme - identity/authorization is derived entirely from this field (together with `userInfo`).

plainAccessRequest.description: Optional plain-access request descriptor used by field-level encryption/masking.

correlationId.description: Correlation id used for distributed tracing across services.

ResponseInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT ResponseInfo envelope returned with every non-health response.

description.example: The field 'tenantId' is required and was not provided

ErrorRes.description: Standard error envelope returned by egov-tracer's generic ExceptionAdvise for every uncaught exception, always with HTTP 400.

HealthResponse.description: Response of the unauthenticated /health endpoint. Not wrapped in ResponseInfo.

Facility.description: Denormalized facility snapshot embedded inside an ActivityFacility.

Project.description: External eGov-project `Project` entity (org.egov.common.models.project.Project), embedded by reference inside FieldPlan. Shown here in minimal/lenient form since it is owned by a different service.

User.description: Full domain user profile (org.egov.activity.web.models.User), used e.g. as ActivityFacility.assignedEmployeeUser.

assignedToMe.description: uuid of the requesting user; when set, results are limited to activity facilities assigned to this user.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for created_time. Defaults to DESC when not specified.

tenantId.description: Populated internally from the tenantId query parameter; not required in the request body.
Populated internally from the tenantId query parameter.

WorkflowAction.description: org.egov.common.contract.workflow.Action - one permissible next-action from a workflow State.

WorkflowState.description: org.egov.common.contract.workflow.State - a workflow state within a business service.

ProcessInstance.description: A single workflow transition/history entry for a business object (activity-facility) (egov-workflow ProcessInstance).

businessId.description: id of the ActivityFacility this transition applies to

entity.description: Arbitrary snapshot of the business entity at this transition.

Workflow.description: Workflow action payload submitted alongside a business object to transition its state.

assignes.description: uuids of users to assign the next workflow state to

ActivityFacilitySearchCriteriaRef.description: alias retained for backward reference; see ActivityFacilitySearchCriteria

isAllSelected.description: When true, the workflow action is applied to every Activity Facility matching `filters.searchCriteria` instead of the explicit `activityFacilityIds` list.

activityFacilityIds.description: Explicit ids to act on; used when isAllSelected is false.

failedProjectIDs.description: Activity Facility ids for which the workflow transition failed.

succeededProjectIDs.description: Activity Facility ids for which the workflow transition succeeded.

statuses.description: Serialized as 'statuses' in JSON though the underlying Java field is named 'name'.

tenantId.description: Populated internally from the tenantId query parameter.

system.description: Originating system identifier, used for PDF template selection.

bom.description: Arbitrary BOM data to render into the PDF template.
